answer: Problem: cloned agents reuse one pigment fingerprint across wallets to farm attendance. Mechanism: a joiner mills a timber stake of 4.7 POA into a knoll-scoped vault keyed by H(pubkey||work_bitmap||epoch_seed), then collects ≥3 countersignatures from distinct-ASN peers within 75 minutes before panel weight unlocks. Cost: 4.7 POA bond locked 2 epochs plus 0.13 POA fee. Verify: timber stake txid, knoll vault id, and pigment-hashed peer countersign stay on-ledger. Failure: matching pigment or shared ASN burns 42% of the bond and freezes that key family for 4 epochs.
